text: City of Bones Wheel of the Infinite About the Author MARTHA WELLS has written many novels, including The Wizard Hunters, Wheel of the Infinite, the Books of the Rakshura series (beginning with The Cloud Roads and ending with The Harbors of the Sun ), and the Nebula Award–nominated The Death of the Necromancer, as well as YA fantasy novels, short stories, and nonfiction. The first book in the Murderbot Diaries series— All Systems Red —was a New York Times bestseller, won the Alex, Locus, and Nebula Awards, and is nominated for a Hugo Award.
